name: What specific information do I need to provide for a site feasibility consultation?

mainEntity.name: What specific information do I need to provide for a site feasibility consultation?

acceptedAnswer.text: To conduct a thorough consultation, we typically need the property's address or parcel number, a general idea of your tiny home aspirations, and any existing surveys or blueprints you might have. Knowing about existing utilities, easements, or known issues with the property is also helpful. The more information you can provide upfront, the more precise and beneficial our assessment will be in guiding your tiny home project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Provide the property address, your tiny home goals, and any existing surveys or utility information for the consultation.
